I’m happy to help—just let me double‑check what you’re after!

When you say **“Get the event shoes!”** do you mean:
* **(a)** You know there’s an event whose *ID* is `"shoes"` and you’d like us to pull its full record?
* **(b)** There’s a *custom event specification* titled “Shoes” that hasn’t been enabled yet, and you’d like us to activate it so future shoe‑related events will be tracked?
* **(c)** You simply want to see all events (or specs) that mention “shoe(s)” somewhere in their title/description?

If none of those match your intent, feel free to clarify further. Once I understand better, I’ll make sure to hit the right API endpoint for you.
